item.title: Shiritsu Netori Gakuin -10 nin no Kareshi Mochi Joshikousei o "Netotte Geki Iki" Sasero!-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura, Atelier Sakura DARKNESS
  • 発売日: 2013-12-27
  • スコア: 6.09/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 私立 寝取り学院 －10人の彼氏持ち女子校生を“寝取って激イキ”させろ！－
  • 英語名: Shiritsu Netori Gakuin -10 nin no Kareshi Mochi Joshikousei o “Netotte Geki Iki” Sasero!-

あらすじ

The protagonist is a student attending a private school.

Somehow, many girls at this school already have lovers, which makes him constantly miserable.

However, he has one particular talent.

He is actually very good at sex.

He discovered his talent by mere chance when he assaulted a girl he’d known since childhood.
